prompt: What was the earliest known media use of the theme song used by the show The Last Leg?
answer: The earliest known media use was **Channel 4’s coverage of the 2012 Summer Paralympics**. Public Enemy’s **“Harder Than You Think”** was used as the coverage’s title/theme music—also prominently in Channel 4’s “Meet the Superhumans” Paralympics campaign—before being adopted as the permanent theme of *The Last Leg*.
